sections.title: Webhook Overview
sections.content: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications about payment status changes. When a payment is confirmed, failed, or expires, Bitmopay will send a POST request to your specified callback URL.

sections.title: Webhook Payload
sections.content: All webhook notifications are sent as POST requests with a JSON payload containing payment information.

languages.python:
import hmac
import hashlib
import json
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)

def verify_webhook(payload, signature, secret):
    digest = hmac.new(
        secret.encode('utf-8'),
        payload.encode('utf-8'),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    
    return signature == digest

@app.route('/webhook', methods=['POST'])
def webhook():
    signature = request.headers.get('X-Bitmopay-Signature')
    payload = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    
    if verify_webhook(payload, signature, os.getenv('WEBHOOK_SECRET')):
        data = request.get_json()
        print(f"Payment confirmed: {data['payment']['id']}")
        return 'OK', 200
    else:
        return 'Invalid signature', 400
languages.php:
<?php
function verifyWebhook($payload, $signature, $secret) {
    $digest = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
    return $signature === $digest;
}

$signature = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_BITMOPAY_SIGNATURE'];
$payload = file_get_contents('php://input');
$secret = $_ENV['WEBHOOK_SECRET'];

if (verifyWebhook($payload, $signature, $secret)) {
    $data = json_decode($payload, true);
    error_log('Payment confirmed: ' . $data['payment']['id']);
    http_response_code(200);
    echo 'OK';
} else {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo 'Invalid signature';
}
?>
